sentence: This project studies how chemical cues direct fiber-like solids to form nanoscale crystals and how their optical properties change with size.
This project works to make extracellular vesicles, which are sacs that carry material between cells, in large amounts for use as drug carriers.
This project builds computer tools that use artificial intelligence and data science to understand, predict and prevent disease.
This project builds a tool that tests how drugs move across the placental barrier, using 3D cell culture, sensing and imaging.
This project studies how the two parts of a hormone receptor protein communicate with each other to control which genes are turned on.
This project studies how random sampling of points from a shape can show which shapes have the smallest perimeter.
This project builds computer tools that make genome sequencing faster and more power-efficient.
This project studies how often cells make errors when splicing RNA and why some erroneous RNAs escape quality control.
This project studies how seeds arriving in grasslands help keep many kinds of plants growing there.
This project uses computer simulations to study materials with diffuse electrons between their layers.
This project builds foundation models that detect threats in large amounts of spatiotemporal data.
This project builds computer methods that detect cyber-attacks on chemical process control systems and keep them running safely.
This project builds a wearable device that detects volatile organic compounds from the skin to predict epileptic seizures before they begin.
This project studies how rural teachers bring artificial intelligence and cybersecurity into their existing lessons.
This project designs hardware that speeds up a digital signature scheme meant to resist attacks from quantum computers.
This project builds silicon photonic devices that trap charges for optical memory, computing and label-free genetic sequencing.
